text.p: Following are some of the main
stories in Dutch newspapers today. Reuters has not verified
these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
FINANCIEELE DAGBLAD
- Dutch wage costs not expected to rise significantly next
year, says central planning bureau (CPB). (p1)
- Small and medium-sized-businesses association MKB studies
possibility of setting up own unemployment and disablilty
insurance scheme. (p1)
- Investment company HAL takes one third stake in the
Schreiner Luchtvaart Group. (p3)
- Supermarket concern Schuitema books strong
growth in market share to 10.5 pct from 7.5 pct. (p4)
VOLKSKRANT
- Automation firm UCC seeks listing on NMAX bourse for new
fast-growing companies to finance its expansion. (p2)
- Entertainment group Endemol euphoric about
mega-deal with German commercial TV station RTL. (p2)
- Authorities in northern Dutch port of Eemshaven want to
dismantle oil rigs. (p13)
DE TELEGRAAF
- Cabinet considering 3.5 bn guilders reduction in financial
burden on consumers and businesses next year. (p3)
- Dredger Boskalis places first tunnel element
for the Oresund link between Denmark and Sweden. (p19)
- Philips Electronics new model GSM already a giant
success. (p21) -
TROUW
- Plastic tube maker Wavin takes over two
subsidiaries from Ten Cate. (p6) -
